help.title: How to use
help.intro: Inventory helps you remember where your things are: take a photo, say where you put it, and find it later in seconds.

approval.title: Account approval
points: After sign-up, the administrator must approve your account.
Until then, after signing in you only see “Your account is awaiting approval” and a Sign out button.
Once approved, refresh the page or sign in again.

install.title: Install on your phone
points: iPhone: open the site in Safari → Share → “Add to Home Screen”.
Android: open the site in Chrome → ⋮ → “Install app”.
The app then opens from its icon like any other.

places.title: Places
points: Places nest inside each other: house → room → closet → shelf, as deep as you need.
Add places in “Places” or by voice while adding an item.
Moved a closet? Move it in the app — the items inside move with it.

here.title: “I'm here” mode
points: Pick a place once, e.g. “Country house → Garage → Rack”.
Every new item goes there: photograph things in a row without choosing a place each time.
The current place is shown in the header, where you can change or clear it.
The place you choose while adding an item (from the list or by voice) is your "I'm here": it stays on every screen. Reset it with the × in the header.
The Items tab opens on your "I'm here" place (with everything nested). Pick another place or "All places" in the filter.

"I'm here" is one place for the whole app: choosing it in the header, while adding an item or in the Items filter (and "All places" / "Reset", which clear it) changes it everywhere at once. Only "Move" of an item or moving a place changes that thing's place, not yours.

languages.title: Data languages
points: Settings → “Data languages”: English only, Russian only, or both. The interface language is chosen separately.
Russian only: you write in Russian, the English translation appears by itself in the background.
When you turn on Russian after English, the app offers to translate your records in packs. You can do it later: a record without a translation has a Translate button.
Changing the mode deletes nothing: the other language is just hidden and comes back when you switch again.

add.title: Add an item
points: Tap the camera at the bottom → "One item" and take a photo of the item.
AI fills in the name, description and category.
Say where you put it and what it is: “it's dad's old drill, put it in the garage on the rack”.
Check the suggestions and tap “Save”.
If this photo was added before, the app shows those items before recognizing — no AI limit is used.

multi.title: A whole shelf or tool board
points: Add screen → "Several items in one photo". Handy for a shelf, a tool board, a drawer.
The AI finds up to 30 items and cuts each one out of the photo. It is one AI request.
Check the list: untick what you do not need, fix names and categories. One place for all — "I'm here" by default.
Each item gets its cut-out as the main photo and the whole photo as the second. Shoot straight on, in good light, items not covering each other.
Repeats: if the same photo was added before, the app says so before asking the AI. Found items similar to ones you already have come unticked — you decide.

books.title: Books
points: Take a photo of the cover: the AI fills in the title (as printed, not translated), the author, and the year and ISBN if they are visible.
Take a photo of the back cover with the barcode: the app reads the ISBN itself and finds the book in open catalogues. No AI is used. Need more — "Recognize from photo".
A shelf of books: "Several items in one photo" — every book becomes its own card, titles and authors are read from the spines.
Books go to the "Books" category. If you have none, the app offers to create it.
Search by author or ISBN: "Tolkien" or the number with or without hyphens.

dictation.title: Voice in text fields
points: Next to an item's name and description, a place name and a category name there is a mic: tap, speak, tap again.
The AI writes down what you said in the field's language: fixes obvious mistakes and adds punctuation, but never retells. The EN field always gets English.
The text appears under the field: "Replace", "Append to the end" or "Cancel". Nothing changes without a tap.
One recording is one AI request. With both languages, after a change you can "Update translation" of the other one.

find.title: Find an item
points: Plain search: type a word — “drill”.
Smart search: tap the mic and ask “where is my drill?” — AI adds similar words and understands places.
Results show photos and the full place path.

views.title: Gallery and table
points: In “Items”, switch between a photo gallery and a compact table.
Filter by category and by place — including all nested places.

bulk.title: Many items at once
points: In Items or in Search results tap "Select" or press and hold an item. Tick the ones you need.
"Select all found" takes every item of the current filters or search, not only those on screen (up to 500 at a time).
At the bottom: "Category", "Move" (from the list, by voice or straight to "I'm here"), "Delete" and "Categorize".

"Categorize": the AI reads only the items' texts (no photos) and suggests categories, sometimes new ones. You see "was → will be" first: untick what you don't want and tap "Apply". 50 items = one AI request.
After a change an "Undo" button stays at the bottom for 10 seconds: every item gets its previous value back. Deleting cannot be undone.

categories.title: Categories
points: A standard set is ready: tools, kitchen, clothing and more.
In “Settings” you can rename and delete categories or add your own.

plan.title: Plan
points: Settings show your plan: items out of the limit and AI requests in 24 hours.
When you reach the plan's item limit, new items and every AI feature are turned off. Browsing, editing, plain search and deleting keep working.
A lower plan deletes nothing. Delete what you do not need and everything works again.
The administrator sets your plan, sometimes until a date; after it the plan goes back to Free by itself.

tips.title: Tips
points: The "←" arrow at the top returns to the previous screen with the same filters, view and scroll position. If you opened a screen by a link, it goes to its parent: item → Items, place → the place above. Swipe back on iPhone works too.
Photograph items close up on a light background — AI recognizes them better.
Say the full place path: “at the country house, in the garage, on the rack”.
Allow the microphone and camera when the browser asks.
No mic at hand? Everything works with typed text too.
